'''This skirmish''' occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> within the labyrinthine bowels of the [[Arbo Maze]], a copse of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] so thick that the woods formed cavernous tunnels. During the altercation, the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Umwak]] and [[Umwak's nephew|his nephew]] attempted to capture the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]]; Umwak attacked these unarmed opponents empty-handed, but his nephew wielded a [[Net/Legends|net]] soaked in ultra-sticky [[ganga sap]]. Despite several attempts to trap her, Kneesaa maneuvered herself so that Umwak and his nephew collided with one another, entangling them in their own net. The Ewoks rendezvoused with their friends&mdash;[[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], [[Weechee Warrick|Weechee]], [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle]], and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]]&mdash;and left the Duloks in the maze.<ref name="TOL">{{Ewoks|The Tree of Light}}.</ref>
